einzeiler: Nate Silver and the Still Counting crew analyze upcoming Senate races and polls.
kurzfassung: Nate Silver, Clare Malone, and Galen Druke discuss key Senate races and Republican midterm prospects with Lovett. The conversation covers expected polling errors and candidate performance patterns. They also explain the methodology behind Nate's FLIPR election forecast model.
stichpunkte: Discussion of notable Senate races for the midterms
Analysis of Republican midterm strategy and potential losses
Evaluation of expected polling errors for November
Comparison of candidates who overperform versus underperform
Examination of the science behind the FLIPR forecast model
beschreibung:
Nate Silver, Clare Malone, and Galen Druke — the hosts of Crooked Media's new show Still Counting — join Lovett to talk about the Senate races they find most interesting and Trump doing everything in his power to help Republicans lose the midterms. The crew, who you may remember from the FiveThirtyEight podcast, dives deep into the numbers, breaking down what polling errors we should expect this November, what kind of candidates overperform versus underperform the national average, and the science behind Nate's midterm election forecast model, FLIPR.
Subscribe to Still Counting on YouTube or wherever you get your podcasts.
